title: Normalized derived Cech descent followed by exact inverse image
statement:
Let $\mathcal X,\mathcal Y,\mathcal B$ be topoi of sheaves on small sites in fixed larger coefficient universes [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-size-convention]. Give them sheaves of commutative rings and module categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $f:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y$ and $h:\mathcal B\to\mathcal Y$ be morphisms of ringed topoi with Cartesian coefficient identifications, so that their module inverse images are exact. Let $v:V\to1_{\mathcal X}$ be an epimorphism of sheaves of sets. Let $\mathcal X_n=\mathcal X/(V^{\times(n+1)})$, with localized coefficient rings, and $v_n:\mathcal X_n\to\mathcal X$ the localization morphisms [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. For a module sheaf $K$ on $\mathcal X$ put $K_n=v_n^*K$. Use ordinary total right derived direct images and unbounded module derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The augmented Cech nerve induces a natural isomorphism
$$h^*Rf_*(K[0])\ \cong\operatorname{Tot}_{n\geq0}\bigl(h^*R(fv_n)_*(K_n[0])\bigr).$$
The totalization is that of a nonnegative cosimplicial derived object, computed from a compatible first-quadrant resolution with total differential $d_{\mathrm{Cech}}+(-1)^n d_{\mathrm{res}}$ in Cech degree $n$. All diagrams are small. The arrow from the left is the augmentation, degree zero is restriction of sections, and evaluation on $V$ is the direct-image counit. The isomorphism is natural in $K$, in refinements of the covering, and in exact coefficient-restriction functors which commute with the displayed underived direct images and inverse images. Exact inverse image commutes with this first-quadrant totalization: only finitely many terms contribute in each total degree. No assertion that exact inverse image preserves an arbitrary unbounded product totalization is made.
